facts.about: The Company was established in 1981. A joint venture agreement was signed between the Government of India and Suzuki Motor Corporation (SMC), Japan in 1982. The Company became a subsidiary of SMC in 2002.It is the market leader in passenger vehicle segment in India. In terms of production volume and sales, the Company is now SMC’s largest subsidiary. SMC currently holds 56.28% of its equity stake. The principal activities of the Company are manufacturing, purchase and sale of motor vehicles, components and spare parts.

Latest quarter growth (+26%) accelerating vs 3-yr trend (+16%)

business.summary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited is an automotive company engaged in the manufacturing and sale of passenger vehicles and related components. It generates revenue through the sale of vehicles, spare parts, and services in both domestic and international markets.

segments.name: Sale of goods and services
segments.note: Primary revenue source from vehicle and component sales.

narrative.scoreline: Management provided no explicit guidance metrics to track, but delivered solid top-line expansion alongside notable margin compression.
bull: Revenue growth accelerated strongly to 26% YoY in Sep 2026, reaching ₹53,356 crore.
Strong balance sheet with practically zero debt and robust 5-year operating cash to PAT conversion of 118%.
Annual operating cash flows expanded to ₹19,100 crore in FY26, generating ₹8,754 crore in free cash flow.
bear: Quarterly operating margin deteriorated sharply from 13% in Sep 2024 to 9% in Sep 2026.
Net profit dropped to ₹2,466 crore in Sep 2026 from ₹3,349 crore in Sep 2025.
Annual net profit growth stalled in FY26 at ₹14,680 crore despite revenue expanding to ₹183,316 crore.
watch: Check if quarterly operating margins stabilize above 10% in upcoming Q3 results.
